stories.title: Make the end-to-end demo reproducible from the committed scripts (operator runbook)
stories.scope: platform/scripts/README.md — the operator runbook; the one remaining deliverable of this story (absent at HEAD, verified). All seven demo scripts are already tracked at HEAD (verified via git ls-files: seed.mjs, agents.mjs, real-agents.mjs, land.mjs, fanout.mjs, demo-verify.mjs, secret-fixture.mjs) — no tracking work remains. Runbook contents: prerequisite env (CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID; NEXTGIT_PLATFORM to point the scripts at another worker; CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or wrangler login; optional ARTIFACTS_NAMESPACE / NEXTGIT_BASELINE overrides) and wrangler auth; the exact corrected order — (1) seed.mjs (baseline), (2) real-agents.mjs (REAL CLI agents; agents.mjs is the scripted alternative), (3) secret-fixture.mjs (agent-5 secret-class fixture, idempotent), (4) demo-verify.mjs — the terminal pre-recording gate: read-only against the platform, expects every proposal still pending (all-pending; 25/25) — then (5) the recording beats AFTER the gate: the tour/UI beats and the optional landing demo. The runbook must state explicitly that after a landing beat the all-pending gate is NOT re-run — a landed proposal fails demo-verify by design (its 'no landed proposal' assertion); the landing beat proves itself via the UI/land response (receipt, landed badge, push event). Per-step expected observable; scratch outputs (/tmp/real-agents/report.md, /tmp/nextgit-agents.json); retry playbook (real-agents.mjs --only <repo>; SERIAL_RETRY=1 serial retry); no-mocks rule (live Workers + Artifacts end to end).
stories.acceptance: The committed runbook orders seed.mjs -> real-agents.mjs -> secret-fixture.mjs -> demo-verify.mjs, names demo-verify.mjs as the terminal pre-recording gate (all-pending), puts the recording/landing beats after it, and states the all-pending gate is not re-run after a landing beat. Following the runbook to the gate on the demo state, `node platform/scripts/demo-verify.mjs` prints PASS for every check and exits 0 — no proposal landed, N>=4 real proposals with non-empty intents, >=1 genuine collision surfaced pre-land (agent-1 x agent-2 src/auth.ts), secret-class surface masked.
stories.check_cmd: bun -e 'import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";const rd=p=>{try{return readFileSync(p,"utf8")}catch(e){console.error("missing file: "+p);process.exit(2)}};const r=rd("platform/scripts/README.md");const d=rd("platform/scripts/demo-verify.mjs");const need=["seed.mjs","real-agents.mjs","secret-fixture.mjs","demo-verify.mjs"];let pos=-1;for(const s of need){pos=r.indexOf(s,pos+1);if(pos<0){console.error("runbook missing or out of order: "+s);process.exit(1)}}if(!/all[- ]pending/i.test(r)){console.error("runbook must state the all-pending gate");process.exit(1)}if(!/not (re-?run|rerun)/i.test(r)){console.error("runbook must state the gate is not re-run after a landing beat");process.exit(1)}if(!d.includes("no landed proposal")){console.error("demo-verify all-pending assertion missing");process.exit(1)}console.log("OK: runbook order seed -> real-agents -> secret-fixture -> demo-verify; all-pending gate stated")'
stories.notes: Repair round: the runbook carries the corrected gate order — demo-verify.mjs asserts 'no landed proposal — all pending (recording requirement)' (demo-verify.mjs:108), so the hero landing beat comes after the gate and the gate is not re-run post-landing (the landing beat proves itself via the UI/land response). Stale premises fixed: all seven demo scripts are tracked at HEAD (verified via git ls-files); the remaining deliverable is platform/scripts/README.md (absent, verified); the `demo-scenario-reset-fresh-real-agent-fleet` row is [done] (verified in tasks.db). Dedupe: `two-command-reproducible-demo-seed-real-agents` [done] covers the two-command run; `demo-one-repo-3-5-agents-seeded-collision-land-one-scrub-lea` [pending] covers the single-run demo shape; `live-only-e2e-verification-gate-before-submission-no-mocks` [pending] carries the no-mocks gate. This story adds the committed operator runbook only; it does not rewrite script logic.

stories.title: Record and gate the 5-10 minute single-take submission video
stories.scope: Record the submission take following _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/demo/video-script.md (7:30 nominal, 5-10 minute window). Reset the world first (seed.mjs then real-agents.mjs then secret-fixture.mjs), then record one uninterrupted take: cold open with the live URL visible, the fleet (>=4 real proposals + intents + event ticker), the collision (src/auth.ts text-conflict pair), the judge chips, the click (preview merge then land then receipt commit + landed badge + push event), the close. Real infrastructure only, no mocks, no cuts, no devtools. Store the recording at submission/nextgit-demo.mp4.
stories.acceptance: A single uninterrupted take exists at submission/nextgit-demo.mp4; ffprobe reports a duration within 300-600 seconds; the take shows every beat of video-script.md in order on the live platform — a fleet of >=4 real agent proposals, >=1 genuine collision surfaced, judge chips rendered, one-click landing with receipt; it is the single submitted entry.
stories.check_cmd: test -f submission/nextgit-demo.mp4 && ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 submission/nextgit-demo.mp4 | awk '{exit !($1 >= 300 && $1 <= 600)}'
stories.notes: Dedupe: `demo-video-5-10-min-single-take-covering-all-three-axes` [pending] and `record-edit-the-submission-video` [pending] name the recording act; `video-script-storyboard` [done] is the narrative; `qa-demo-video-frames-for-readability-and-key-moments` [pending] carries frame QA. This story is the executable single-take gate (duration window + beat coverage + canonical file path) only.

stories.title: Add the mechanical runtime-pin guard and reconcile pinned surfaces
stories.scope: porting/tests/runtime-pin.test.mjs, written in the repo's direct-run bun convention: '#!/usr/bin/env bun' plus a header comment 'Run: bun porting/tests/runtime-pin.test.mjs (exit 0 = pass)' — the tasks/batch/judge/normalize precedent — NOT bun:test imports (a bun:test file run directly on bun 1.3.14 exits 1). Asserts: platform/wrangler.jsonc name is nextgit-platform, compatibility_date is 2026-09-01, compatibility_flags contains no nodejs_compat; platform/package.json asserts the EXISTING engines pin ({"node": ">=20"} — present at HEAD; do not add it) and that scripts never reference wrangler@latest; operational docs (docs/HANDOFF.md, .omp/agents.md) carry no wrangler@latest deploy instruction — docs/HANDOFF.md currently says 'npx wrangler@latest deploy' and must be reconciled to the lockfile-pinned local wrangler run from platform/ (.omp/agents.md is already compliant); no console log call in platform/src/**/*.ts references Authorization headers or request bodies.
stories.acceptance: bun porting/tests/runtime-pin.test.mjs exits 0 on the reconciled tree; it exits non-zero when the compatibility date changes, nodejs_compat is added, a script or operational doc re-introduces wrangler@latest, the engines pin is removed, or a platform/src log call references Authorization or request bodies.
stories.notes: Repair round: platform/package.json already pins engines node >=20 at HEAD (verified) — the guard asserts the existing pin, it does not add it; wrangler.jsonc already satisfies the pin (compat 2026-09-01, no compatibility_flags); the stale surface is docs/HANDOFF.md's 'npx wrangler@latest deploy' line. Dedupe: `deploy-pinning-policy-lockfile-wrangler-artifacts-cli-flag-4` [done] is the policy statement; `ensure-hermetic-reproducible-builds-with-pinned-images` [pending] covers hermetic CI images; `pin-isomorphic-git-1-42-x-never-disk-checkout-untrusted-tree` [pending] pins the git dep.
